show.description: Once a humble house help in the Malhotra mansion, Anaya’s world shattered when arrogant heir Daksh Malhotra broke her trust and dignity. Years later, she returns transformed into a confident, powerful woman to infiltrate his world, unmask his secrets, and make him pay for every wound he left behind. Watch Now!
